title: OrikingCraft
description: This mod is a multi-model accessory pack
body:
This mod is a multi-model accessory pack, including: military sand walls, shelves, food coolers, weapon cases, shell casings, and the remains of combat personnel, which can enhance the player's immersion.

It's primarily used for landscaping or adding immersion to modpacks; all blocks are purely decorative and have no effects.

The original mod is version 1.12.2, and the author may have stopped updating it, so I created this ported mod.
